title: Response to Comments on Kämmerer, et al. (2023) regarding RT-PCR Testing
claim: the recorded quote was verbatim on the opened page
quote: They point to the lack of a specific definition of COVID-19 disease and conclude that, in order to test the first and the second of Koch’s postulates, there must be both a purified germ and a specified disease, neither of which was available for COVID-19. In reply, we address two questions they did not ask: ... 2. Are Koch’s postulates valid for viruses?
